correctness.rationale: A finite transient CTMC indexed by unobserved infected counts i,j has absorption-inclusive diagonal -[j(3-i)+i(4-j)], and transition rates j(3-a-i), i(1+a-j). Its exact four survival exponential-polynomial formulas follow from triangular linear ODEs. Independent 15-state individual-subset generator matches 20 Taylor derivatives for each placement, and Cayley-Hamilton makes this an exact identity check rather than numerical fitting. S2-S3 positive by a cubic sign bound, S1-S3 positive using -log x>=1-x and positive-discriminant-free quadratic, and S0-S3=x^3(1-x)R(x)/280 with R strictly concave and a unique zero. Direct exponential integration gives ET3=4/(21lambda), ET0=139/(630lambda). No claim for nonuniform seeds, recovery, or heterogeneous hazards.
